data.name: Wings of Fire
data.description: As a swift action, you can manifest a pair of fiery wings that grant you a fly speed of 60 feet with average maneuverability. You can use these wings for %1 minutes per day. This duration does not need to be consecutive, but it must be spent in 1 minute increments.|classlevel("Oracle")
